BODY.VAR: select * from RABAEV.RRL_PRIHOD_NAKLAD NAK where NAK.ID = [nakl_id]

TABLE.name: table_1
TABLE.SQL: select ART.NAME Товар, PAL.UID_PALLET ПАЛЛЕТ, (PAL.WEIGHT_BRUTTO ) ВЕСБРУТТОИТН, PAL.UNIT_COUNT ШТУКИ , (RABAEV.RRL_PRIHODPALLET_CALC_WEIGHT( UID_PALLET , PAL.UNIT_COUNT , 2 ) ) Нетто , (RABAEV.RRL_PRIHODPALLET_CALC_WEIGHT( UID_PALLET , PAL.UNIT_COUNT , 1 ) ) Брутто , PAL.WEIGHT_TN Вес_ТН, concat( to_char( PAL.DEFECT_PERC ) , '%' ) Отход , RRL_GET_MOD_INFO( MOD_ID ) ФАСОВКА , RRL_COUNT_KOR2( PAL.ARTICUL , PAL.UNIT_COUNT , PAL.MOD_ID ) КОРОБКИ from RABAEV.RRL_PRIHOD_NAKLAD NAK , RABAEV.RRL_PALLETS PAL , RABAEV.RRL_ARTICULS ART where NAK.ID = PAL.PRIHOD_NAKLAD_ID and ART.ACTICUL = PAL.ARTICUL and NAK.ID = [nakl_id]

TABLE.name: table_2
TABLE.SQL:
select ART.NAME Товар, sum( ((PAL.WEIGHT_BRUTTO-PAL.WEIGHT_TN ) *(100- PAL.DEFECT_PERC ) ) / 100 ) ПРИНЯТО , sum ((PAL.WEIGHT_BRUTTO-PAL.WEIGHT_TN)) ВЕС_С_БРАКОМ , sum( ((PAL.WEIGHT_BRUTTO-PAL.WEIGHT_TN ) *( PAL.DEFECT_PERC ) ) / 100 ) ВЕС_БРАКА , sum( RRL_COUNT_KOR2( PAL.ARTICUL , PAL.UNIT_COUNT , PAL.MOD_ID ) ) КОРОБКИ , round(100* sum( ((PAL.WEIGHT_BRUTTO-PAL.WEIGHT_TN ) *( PAL.DEFECT_PERC ) ) / 100 ) / sum ((PAL.WEIGHT_BRUTTO-PAL.WEIGHT_TN ) ) , 2 ) ПРОЦЕНТ_БРАКА ,
sum( (RABAEV.RRL_PRIHODPALLET_CALC_WEIGHT( UID_PALLET , PAL.UNIT_COUNT , 2 )*(100- PAL.DEFECT_PERC ) ) / 100 ) ВесНетто
from RABAEV.RRL_PRIHOD_NAKLAD NAK , RABAEV.RRL_PALLETS PAL , RABAEV.RRL_ARTICULS ART where NAK.ID = PAL.PRIHOD_NAKLAD_ID and ART.ACTICUL = PAL.ARTICUL and NAK.ID = [nakl_id] group by ART.NAME
